# AI Usage Permissions for Classifast.com

## Allowed AI Interactions
- Content analysis and classification
- SEO optimization suggestions  
- Code review and improvement recommendations
- Accessibility enhancements
- Performance optimization guidance
- Semantic HTML structure improvements
- ARIA accessibility implementation
- Security analysis and recommendations

## Prohibited AI Activities
- Automated content generation for production use
- Data scraping or harvesting
- Security testing or vulnerability exploitation
- Bulk automated requests
- Credential discovery or harvesting
- Malicious code creation or modification

## Technical Guidelines
- Respect rate limits (20 requests per minute)
- Follow semantic web standards
- Maintain accessibility compliance (WCAG 2.1)
- Preserve existing functionality during modifications

## Contact Information
For questions about AI usage permissions, contact: dmitry@classifast.com
